title: TIC Industry Dashboard
subtitle: Testing, inspection and certification: listed-company news, financials and share-price indexes

banner._readme: The banner on every screen. The middle sentence is chosen by how much a person has signed off: none, part or all. tools/render.py fills the {slots}.
banner.intro: Compiled by an AI assistant from public sources on {as_of}.
banner.none: No figure has yet been checked by a person.
banner.part: A person has checked {checked} of {sourced} sourced figures, and {px_done} of {px_total} share-price sources.
banner.all: {who} checked every sourced figure and share price against its source {when}.
banner.outro: Company measures differ and are not like-for-like. This is not investment advice.

review.how: A figure counts as checked when a person has signed off its source: they opened the source and compared every figure that cites it. A sign-off lapses when one of those figures is later added or changed, and the count drops until a person checks again.

evidence_labels.verified_public_record: Taken from a regulatory filing or a regulated exchange announcement, or a faithful copy of one.
evidence_labels.company_claim: Stated by the company outside a regulated results document. Every outlook and target carries this label.
evidence_labels.secondary_report: Taken from news coverage, a call summary, a data aggregator or an adviser note. Replace with the company document when it is available.
evidence_labels.computed: Calculated here from other figures on the page. The formula is shown in the table notes.
evidence_labels.not_found_in_scoped_search: Looked for and not found in the sources used. Never estimated.

comparability: Profit measures differ. UL Solutions, Eurofins and TIC Solutions report adjusted EBITDA; SGS, Bureau Veritas and Intertek report an adjusted operating profit after depreciation; ALS reports underlying EBIT. The overview charts keep the two families apart.

Growth measures differ. Intertek reports like-for-like growth at constant currency; the others report organic growth on their own definitions. TIC Solutions also gives a combined growth rate that treats NV5 as owned in both periods.
Reporting periods differ. ALS has a 31 March year end, so its half year runs April to September. SGS, Bureau Veritas, Intertek and Eurofins publish revenue only at Q1 and Q3.
Currencies are left as reported: USD, CHF, EUR, GBP and AUD. Nothing is converted, so revenue figures cannot be added or ranked across companies.
Each year is shown as it appears in the most recent release that presents it. Later restatements can change comparatives; where a restated figure is used, the table notes say so.
known_gaps: ALS half-year FY27 figures (released 23 November 2026) come from press coverage only. Replace them with the ASX release and Appendix 4D.

SGS: net debt was not found for the end of 2025 or 2021, nor leverage for 2025, 2022 or 2021. Sales by business line were not captured. FY2024 and FY2025 profit attributable come from secondary sources. Nine-month 2026 sales are added up here, because the update gives the quarter only.

UL Solutions: growth for FY2021 and organic growth before FY2024 were not found. Debt, cash and regular dividends before FY2024 were mostly not captured. The first-quarter 2026 release was not captured; Q1 revenue is derived.
Bureau Veritas: annual figures come from the company's key-figures web page, not the Universal Registration Document. Nine-month 2026 revenue is on a new basis and does not equal H1 plus Q3.
Intertek: FY2025 statutory profit after tax was not found. Revenue by division was not captured. Equity and enterprise values for the EQT offer differ between sources.
Eurofins: FY2025 figures are preliminary and unaudited. Group organic growth for FY2024 was not captured. FY2021 to FY2023 organic growth is for the core business only.

TIC Solutions: only three years are shown, because figures before 2023 were not found. 2023 and part of 2024 belong to the Predecessor, and NV5 joins from 4 August 2025, so year-on-year growth is not like-for-like. Operating cash flow for 2023 and 2024 was not captured.
ALS: FY22 return on capital employed was not found. FY22 revenue and profit are on a continuing-operations basis, while its growth rates are as first reported, before Asset Care was taken out.
Next results dates were found only for SGS and ALS.

Share prices and market caps come from market-data sites, not from the exchanges. UL Solutions month-end prices before November 2025 and TIC Solutions market caps before October 2026 were not captured; the TIC stock price screen says how the indexes handle this.
Valuation multiples and analyst consensus are out of scope for this version.
